blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — What would you do if you are visiting China? For Ellen Adarna, the answer is simple: get yourself a “magical” Chinese makeup transformation and live the Chinese Drama (C-Drama) fantasy through a photoshoot. In a series of Instagram posts, the 38-year-old Cebuana internet personality shared in photos her “When in China” looks, glamming up in the famous Chinese makeup style “Douyin,” while donning traditional Chinese and C-drama-inspired outfits.
